idea-plugin.name: agentdata fleet
idea-plugin.description:
Hosts the ad-fleet serve dashboard in a tool window, and relays its notifications as IDE balloons.

A shell only: every rule about what an agent is doing and whether it needs you lives in the fleet itself, so the tool window, the browser and the VS Code view always agree.

action.text: Start a Fleet Agent on This Project…
action.description: Start a headless agent on this repository through the fleet
